target_split: sha256('vcc-v2:' + target) modulo 5: 0 outer test, 1 inner validation, 2/3/4 inner training
outer_validation: Whole destination context held out; test targets excluded from all transfer training contexts
selection: Mean inner held-out-context MSE divided by that context's zero-effect MSE; do not select from outer test or H1
effect_space: log1p(50000 * pseudobulk mean / sum over shared official genes) minus control profile
self_target_gene: Masked in transfer training and MSE/correlation; all evaluation panel target genes removed for PDS proxy
ensemble: hybrid = equal-weight gene_shrink and lowrank prediction; weight fixed before evaluation
postprocessing: Project predicted profile to nonnegative normalized count simplex using only destination controls, then score the projected profile
missing_targets: Zero-effect fallback unless a separate held-out-target experiment supports an alternative
